Firefighters rescued a trapped dog from the rubble. Colombia has declared three days of national mourning. Tons of aid from regional partners have begun arriving. Rescue operations continue in Cali, Pereira, and the Chocó region; a woman was pulled alive from a collapsed hotel in Pereira after 36 hours. The US Fairfax County Urban Search and Rescue Team has deployed a 10-person contingent. Mexican volunteer group Topos Azteca has arrived in Colombia to assist, but Colombia separately rejected Mexico's military rescue team — Mexico said its military rescuers were refused entry, while Colombia denies politics played a role. Hospitals in Cali sustained damage, forcing medical staff to prioritize critical patients. Civilian databases still estimate ~4,000 missing versus the official figure of ~500. Conspiracy theories falsely blaming an Alaska research program for the earthquake have spread on social media.
